# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the open lies outside the opening range and price quickly reverts to VWAP, fading the initial extreme offers a mean‑reversion edge. This captures intraday mean reversion after an extreme open relative to the OR, using VWAP as the reversion target. The setup is distinct from ORB_RETEST_LONG because it requires the open to be outside the OR and uses VWAP (not the OR level) as the reversion target.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If the opening price is above the OR high (or below the OR low) and within the first 30 minutes price crosses VWAP in the opposite direction of the open extreme (i.e., open > OR high and price < VWAP, or open < OR low and price > VWAP), enter a long position at the close of the bar that crosses VWAP.  
**Exit:** Chart‑stop placed at the opposite OR extreme (OR low for longs opened above OR high, OR high for longs opened below OR low); take profit at 1.5R or when price re‑tests the VWAP extremes.  
**Regime hint:** Best in low‑VIX (<15) environments and during the first 60 minutes of the session when the market is choppy rather than strongly trending.
